summary: Claude Team for scientists offers selected verified PIs/equivalents at academic/nonprofit research institutions 12 months of promotional seating: Standard free, Premium $15/month with 5x usage, up to about 10,000 seats. Groups with an institutional Enterprise agreement should contact its admin first. Usually 1–25 seats/group; larger groups contact Anthropic; review generally takes 5–7 business days. Includes Claude Science, Code and Cowork. Legal terms require a valid payment method for Team enrollment, one plan per lab, and discount seat fees only; extra usage is separately billed. After 90 days of inactivity, marketing/help describe return to standard pricing, while legal terms allow ending the promotion and account deactivation; clarify this before relying on continued access. Unless canceled, seats renew at then-current recurring rates after the promotional period. A separate, claimable monthly API benefit grants $20 per qualifying Standard seat and $100 per Premium seat, pooled up to $500 based on seats when granted. The plan must be active/in good standing for seven days. A Team Owner/Primary Owner with Console Owner/Admin/Billing rights links one Console organization and accepts Supplemental Credit Terms. No Console card is needed for that API allowance; this does not waive the Team enrollment payment method. API credits expire each billing cycle without rollover and exclude interactive Claude Code and Claude-app extra usage. Monitor purchased balances, auto-reload and paid continuation. This is distinct from AI for Science grants; public terms were checked, not account redemption.
claim_steps: Confirm PI/equivalent status at an accredited university or nonprofit research institute in an eligible field. Check for an institutional Claude Enterprise agreement: if one exists, contact its administrator first; this plan is for groups without one.
Wait for review (most applications 5–7 business days) and the approval email.

Before enrollment, read the promotional terms: a valid payment method is required for the Team plan, one plan per lab, and only seat fees are discounted. Extra usage is billed separately; the no-Console-card API allowance is a different benefit.
Add lab members as Standard (free) or Premium ($15/mo) seats. Final pricing is confirmed after verification.

Keep the group active. Marketing/help say 90 days of inactivity may restore standard pricing; legal terms also allow ending the promotion and deactivating the account. After the promotion, cancel before renewal if you do not want then-current recurring charges.

After seven days on an active eligible plan in good standing, a Team Owner/Primary Owner opens Organization settings → Billing → API credits → Link organization. Confirm the qualifying seat balance shown.
Choose one Console organization where you have Owner/Admin/Billing rights and accept Supplemental Credit Terms; only one plan can fund that organization.
Use credits within the billing cycle; no rollover or interactive Claude Code/app-extra-usage coverage. Monitor purchased credits and auto-reload to avoid paid continuation.

social_proof.title: Claude Team plan for scientists | Claude by Anthropic
social_proof.text: 10,000 scientists around the world can now get Claude at no cost to start. Verified principal investigators qualify for a Claude Team subscription plan and then add their research team to Standard Seats for free, or Premium seats for $15 per month. Promotional pricing for 12 months.

social_proof.title: Expanding our support for scientists
social_proof.text: We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year through our new Claude team plan for scientists. Standard seats will be free and premium seats with 5x usage limits will be available for $15 per month.

social_proof.title: Promotional pricing inactivity condition
social_proof.text: If a group has no activity for 90 days, we may return it to standard Team pricing so the promotional seats go to active researchers. We'll email the admin before that happens.

social_proof.title: Scientists plan monthly API credit benefit
social_proof.text: On the Team plan for scientists, you’ll receive $20 USD per Standard seat and $100 USD per Premium seat. Credits for all seats are pooled into one monthly balance, capped at $500.

social_proof.title: Monthly API credit seat calculation and eligibility
social_proof.text: The pool is calculated from the seats on the plan when the credits are granted. Eligibility Active plan. Your Max or Team subscription must be active and in good standing. Seven days on the plan. New subscribers can claim once they've been on an eligible plan for seven days.

social_proof.title: Console organization linking and credit terms
social_proof.text: In the API credits section, select "Link organization." Choose the Console organization you want to receive the credits, or create a new one. Review the Supplemental Credit Terms, then Link organization.

social_proof.title: Scientists plan — institutional Enterprise agreement check
social_proof.text: Check with your institution first. If your campus has a Claude agreement, contact your account administrator. This plan is for small research groups whose institutions don’t have an enterprise agreement in place.

social_proof.title: Scientists promotional terms — enrollment payment method and billing
social_proof.text: To redeem the Promotion you must have an Anthropic account, be located in a region where the Plan is available, and provide a valid payment method.
